items.why: Hosted cloud emulator or cloud iPhone (MIT code, paid service). It cannot push our rendered videos onto a device, which the Short and TikTok jobs need. About $67 a month at our volume on cloud Android, or $80-100 flat on iPhone, against $0 for the owner's own phone through OpenDeviceMCP. Runs the owner's logins on a vendor's machine. Revisit only if the owner's home host stays unreachable for a week and the owner approves a paid trial.
items.steal: A bounded device session: a device start that ends itself on timeout, so a missing phone stops the job instead of retrying. Candidate for the faceless-phone-host skill.
items.owner: Any trial needs the owner's yes: money (cloud device minutes or a flat plan) and a third-party account.
